prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1358; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene in Conroe, Texas, I observed two vehicles in the southbound lane of the roadway with front-end damage consistent with a low-speed head-on collision. Driver 1 was seated in the driver's seat of the first vehicle and stated that the other vehicle crossed into their lane while attempting to pass a slower car. Driver 2 stated they had been traveling within the posted limit and were attempting to avoid the other vehicle when contact occurred. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was present and was not visibly injured. Driver 1 reported striking their head on the steering wheel and experiencing dizziness, confusion, and a headache, consistent with a possible concussion. Emergency medical services were requested and evaluated Driver 1 on scene. Both vehicles were driven from the roadway after documentation was completed. Airbags deployed in Driver 1's vehicle. Weather was clear and the road surface was dry at the time of the incident.
